project_info.title: Geometry becomes an auditable meaning system

outline.title: Geometry becomes an auditable meaning system
outline.summary: A reconstruction of the Geometric Unity transcript and Sovereign Engine repository, from tensor calculus and bundles to verifiable software operations.

outline.title: The project is four systems at once
outline.summary: Explain the runtime, knowledge-kernel, translation-platform, and embodied-learning identities of Sovereign Engine.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/projects/sov-e4e91854/meaning_planes_chart.png - Bar chart showing the five interlocking planes/systems of the meaning layer

outline.title: GU changes the arena, not just the equation
outline.summary: Show X4, the ten independent metric components, and the resulting Y14 metric-bundle count, with a clear boundary between mathematics and physical claims.

outline.title: The observer is a relationship package
outline.summary: Explain base point, fiber, section, connection, pullback, and observation map as one structured package.

outline.title: Tensor calculus supplies the physical vocabulary
outline.summary: Map metric, connection, curvature, torsion, and contortion to their physical meanings and Engine analogues.

outline.title: Curvature becomes a testable chain
outline.summary: Present the chain from connection to Riemann, Ricci, scalar curvature, and Einstein tensor, including Bianchi conservation.

outline.title: Gauge geometry explains the transcript’s D² language
outline.summary: Show A, F, D, D², and the Bianchi identity as executable geometric invariants.

outline.title: Spinors and rolled-up complexes are hypotheses, not magic
outline.summary: Explain the Dirac operator and even/odd complex packaging while marking three-generation claims as unresolved GU hypotheses.

outline.title: The Engine’s trusted core is small
outline.summary: Define the deterministic kernel: canonical objects, typed indices, operations, invariant registry, evidence replay, and explicit statuses.

outline.title: APIs turn equations into contracts
outline.summary: Summarize the proposed API surface for manifolds, metrics, connections, curvature, forms, spinors, and claims.

outline.title: Development follows a staged verification spine
outline.summary: Present the T0–T7 implementation sequence from canonical AST through tensor kernel, provenance, adapters, and GU hypothesis modules.
outline.image_plan: /home/ubuntu/projects/sov-e4e91854/source_surface_chart.png - Bar chart displaying the staged verification spine and artifact inventory of the repository

outline.title: The meaning layer’s final promise
outline.summary: Close with the project’s defensible promise: inspectable representations, transformations, assumptions, and evidence—not an unsupported theory-of-everything claim.
